messages:
mike: Post-QA: integrity check failed for rc3 image — cosign attestation missing for baseimage. Deploy window in 2h. Need quick decision: pin digest and proceed, wait for signer, or regional carveout? /cc @anya @jess

deploybot: deploybot: SBOM scan completed for release-rc3 — vuln scan: 2 low, 1 medium (libcrypto). No critical. Cosign attestation: MISSING for image: gcr.io/redwood/redis:rc3

anya: I can ping infra sig for attestation but ETA ~45m. If we wait we'll miss 2h window.

jess: legal: if cosign attestation missing we need documented risk acceptance or timeboxed pin. Prefer timeboxed pin + evidence window. @legal-bot can you confirm escalation path?

legal-bot: legal-bot: For runtime images, policy allows temporary pin with CompOps sign-off if attestation pending <1h. Need release note entry and audit ticket.

priya: SRE: carving out eu-only canary is safest. We can route 10% traffic to eu clusters, rollback on error rate >0.5% in 15m. We have playbook.

mike: Proposal: pin baseimage digest for canary eu only, start canary at +30m, require cosign attestation uploaded within 30m of canary start or we auto-rollback. Release notes to include 'cosign attestation pending — timeboxed pin'. Create audit ticket.

jess: :thumbsup: I approve with that guardrails. I'll add legal note to release notes template.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary rollout at 1749511800 (30m). Canary policy: 10% eu, 15m observe, error threshold 0.5%, auto-rollback enabled. Image pinned to digest: sha256:abcdef1234567890deadbeef

priya: I'll run quick local cosign check and post command: ```cosign verify --key k8s://projects/attestations gcr.io/redwood/redis@sha256:abcdef1234567890deadbeef```

mike: Added audit ticket RH-4821 and release note draft: 'Canary pinned to baseimage digest due to missing cosign attestation. Evidence pending. Policy-approved temporary exception.'

sre-oncall: Oncall ack. I'll watch metrics and have rollback script ready: `kubectl rollout undo` and slack alert channel #release-monitor.

anya: Thanks — I'll follow up with infra sig, will try to get attestation earlier. If we get it before canary start we can unpin.

mike: Decision: proceed with timeboxed eu canary pin. Documented and approved. Will post final status here after canary completes.
